items.description:
CAMZ Maintenance and Solutions is a construction and maintenance company based in Daspoort, Pretoria, registered in 2017. The business describes itself as a credible, trustworthy and reliable construction and maintenance company, offering new-build construction, renovations, plumbing, electrical work, access control and CCTV installation, waterproofing, and steel building construction.

Its work covers domestic, commercial and industrial properties, with recent enquiries including electric fencing contracts for larger sites, such as a 900-metre installation with dual energisers converted to solar power. The company keeps in touch with clients over WhatsApp and email for quotes and project coordination. It suits homeowners and businesses that need a single contractor for both new building work and ongoing property maintenance, and the business operates from Bakhout Street in Daspoort, Pretoria.

Capital DC Security Group is a South African security technology company based in Heatherdale, Akasia, specialising in integrated systems for homes, businesses and institutions. Its security systems installations cover CCTV and IP camera systems, alarm systems and perimeter intrusion detection, while its access control solutions include biometric and RFID access, intercom systems and smart gate and door entry.

The company also handles hardware and software setup, including system integration, remote monitoring setup and smart device connectivity, bringing robust hardware, smart software and skilled installation together under one roof. It was founded to bridge the gap between traditional security services and advanced digital control, with a mission to deliver reliable, scalable and easy-to-use security solutions. It suits homeowners and businesses who want CCTV, alarms and access control integrated into one smart system, and the company is based on 4th Avenue in Heatherdale, Akasia.

Capital Shifters designs and manufactures custom laser-cut steel metal wall art from its workshop at West Hills Business Estate in Sunderland Ridge, Centurion. Its automotive collection covers brands including Alfa Romeo, Aston Martin, Audi, Chevrolet, Ferrari, Fiat, Ford, Honda, Hyundai, Jaguar and Koenigsegg, alongside motorcycle, off-road vehicle, aircraft and Formula 1 pieces, each hand-polished and powder-coated in matte black.

Customers can order a custom vehicle metal wall art piece for a car, SUV or pickup, a custom perspective piece, a custom motorcycle piece or a custom aircraft piece, each started from R980. The range also includes steel keyholders shaped like specific car models, such as a BMW E30 M3 or a Porsche 911 992 GT3 RS. It suits car and motorsport enthusiasts looking for a one-of-a-kind piece of wall art or a themed gift, with every design created by skilled artisans at the Sunderland Ridge workshop.

Cassie Gee Investments CC is a B2B supply and trading company headquartered in Pretoria, established in 2003 and now in its 23rd year of business. The company supplies hardware, building materials, mining equipment, heavy machinery and commodities through more than 500 product categories, positioning itself as one supplier covering a project from foundation to roof.

It also offers renovation and construction services, including full house renovations, new construction and commercial projects, and runs an established export and trading operation with clients in Malawi, Tanzania and elsewhere in Africa, backed by full export documentation. The company promotes wholesale pricing for B2B clients and a 24-hour quote response time. It suits contractors, retailers and importers who want one reliable supply partner instead of juggling several suppliers, and the business is based on Myrtle Street in Clydesdale, Pretoria.

Castanet Drums and Industrial Supply is a wholesale distributor and export procurement agent established in 2022, supplying individuals and factories in South Africa and neighbouring countries with a wide range of industrial supplies. Its packaging materials include various sizes of steel and plastic drums, poly packaging bags, pallets and bearings, and the company also sources other items its non-South African clients specifically require.

Although it buys and sells in bulk as a wholesale distributor, it also supplies and distributes to smaller independent retailers across the country, which gives it pricing exclusive to Castanet and an edge over competitors. Its service categories span factory supplies, mining supplies and agriculture supplies, backed by a simple company structure that allows quick decisions and a dedicated contact person with authority to negotiate on a client's behalf. It suits factories, mines and agricultural operations across the region that need reliable bulk industrial supply, and the business is based on Cresswell Road in Weavind Park.

CCS Business Consultants is a business and financial advisory firm in Waterkloof, Pretoria, practising and perfecting its approach since 1995. Its team of professional business consultants is specialised across a broad set of disciplines, offering financial consulting with sophisticated modelling, analysis, guidance and planning, tax consulting to minimise the complexity of tax matters, and business strategy support for sustainable growth through comprehensive analysis and planning.

Its management consulting service acts as a key strategic partner providing business solutions on demand, while its financial accounting service maintains effective accounting practices for clients. The firm describes its approach as a two-way conversation with each client, built on long-lasting relationships founded on trust, and aimed at enabling financial independence, sustainability and wealth creation in a fair and equitable manner. It suits businesses and individuals who want a holistic, professional advisory partner, and the firm is based on Julius Jeppe Street in Waterkloof.

Central Doors and Projects manufactures and installs garage doors, house doors and frames, and folding and sliding doors from its office in Rooihuiskraal, Centurion, servicing the greater Gauteng area and supplying nationwide. Its wooden range includes a standard door range, a barn door range, a custom door range and wooden gate panels, built from Meranti timber, which the company says is by far the most suitable timber for South African conditions.

Beyond timber, the company also offers aluminium doors in glazed, smooth and frameless glass finishes, and steel doors in insulated and non-insulated ranges, along with door automation and door décor pieces such as handles and hinges. The business positions itself around quality products and service, with pride in its installations and workmanship, giving customers more than one product option under a single roof. It suits homeowners and developers who want standard or custom-made doors matched to their property, and the business is on Panorama Road in Rooihuiskraal.

items.description:
Chas Everitt Pretoria Estate Agents, based at the Park Lane building in Waterkloof Glen, is a franchise office of the Chas Everitt International Property Group offering residential property sales and rentals. The group has been helping South African families move for almost half a century, and describes itself as a family business rooted in strong ethics and values.

Sellers can get an accurate property value estimate based on comparative market analysis and the latest trends and statistics, and list their home online with support from a dedicated property consultant. The agency also connects buyers and sellers to services such as currency transfers, bond origination, conveyancing and sectional title administration through its wider network. It suits homeowners and buyers in Pretoria East who want an agency backed by a long-established national brand, and the office is registered with the PPRA.

Cheyanne's Tattoos and Piercing Studio is a tattoo and piercing studio in Wierda Park, Centurion, established in 1991. The studio offers custom tattoo design, colour work, portraits and tattoo cover-ups, and uses single-use needles and ink for every client to maintain hygiene and safety standards.

The business has built a long local presence in Centurion, with its directory listing registered since 2012 and kept updated with current contact details. Clients have used its online listing to ask practical questions, including about removing home-made tattoos, which the studio responds to directly. It suits people looking for custom tattoo work, cover-ups of old or home-made tattoos, or piercings from an established local studio, and the business is on Theuns van Niekerk Street in Wierda Park.

Chili Suite is an online accounting and business management software provider based in Wapadrand, Pretoria, offering modular tools covering financials, inventory, fixed assets and jobs and time management. Its Financials module, from R149 a month, includes full finance functions such as accounts payable and receivable, cashbooks and the general ledger, with multiple cost centres that roll up, flexible reporting from trial balance to balance sheet, real-time posting and VAT reporting, plus five separate companies included for free.

Its Inventory module, from R49 a month, offers simple yet powerful stock management across multiple warehouses with inter-warehouse transfers, stock takes and adjustments, and real-time posting of selling prices. Users can create invoices and receipts, raise purchase orders, do online bank reconciliations, generate customer statements and view business performance through built-in dashboards. It suits small and medium businesses that want modular, affordable accounting software, with a free 30-day trial available before signing up.

City Lodge Hotel Lynnwood is a 205-room hotel within the Lynnwood Bridge precinct in Pretoria East, part of the City Lodge Hotel Group, giving guests convenient access to a wide range of business, shopping, dining and entertainment options in this modern mixed-use precinct. Its Café hotel restaurant serves a full English and continental breakfast, lunch and dinner daily, and guests can unwind at the sundowner bar or cool off in the swimming pool.

The hotel offers three meeting rooms accommodating 8, 12 and 14 guests, uncapped complimentary WiFi and a fitness room, along with air-conditioned, non-smoking rooms, accessible rooms, same-day laundry service and on-site parking. It suits business travellers who need meeting space close to Pretoria's attractions as well as leisure guests who want an easy, comfortable stay, and the hotel is on the corner of Lynnwood Road and Daventry Street in Lynnwood Bridge.

City Medical Wholesalers is a full-line pharmaceutical wholesaler trading in over 20,000 products, with its head office in Pretoria West. The group started from modest beginnings some 30 years ago and has grown to become the largest privately owned pharmaceutical wholesaler in South Africa, with four state-of-the-art distribution centres strategically located in Pretoria, Durban, Polokwane and Johannesburg.

Its mission is to be the wholesaler of choice to customers across South Africa by consistently providing quality, cost-effective pharmaceutical and related products with a high level of service, and the company says no customer is too big or too small. Built on three strategic pillars of innovation, culture and sustainable growth, the group aims to supply the widest range of quality products at competitive prices through its distribution network. It suits independent and corporate pharmacies, dispensing doctors and hospitals across the country that need a dependable pharmaceutical supply partner, with its head office on Frederick Street in Pretoria West.

Compendium Accounting Solutions is a full-service accounting company established in 1999, based in Val-de-Grace, Pretoria, bringing together accountants, bookkeepers, payroll administrators and company secretaries under one roof. The firm specialises in accounting and tax consulting, offering individual and company tax services, accounting, bookkeeping and advice on financial matters, which it has since broadened to include payroll administration and company secretarial services, including share registers.

Its stated approach lets clients take full control of their business while reducing the monthly overheads associated with accounting and bookkeeping, with talented professionals who act as creative problem-solvers. The firm says it has built long-standing, personal relationships with clients by delivering a superior level of quality accounting and administration services. It suits businesses and individuals who want accounting, tax, payroll and secretarial work handled together, and the firm also has offices in Secunda and KwaZulu-Natal.

items.description:
CycTec Distribution is a B2B distributor of cycling brands based in Samrand Business Park, Centurion, supplying an authorised dealer network rather than selling directly to the public. Its portfolio includes CUBE Bikes, 100%, Lizard Skins, Velo Edge, Ecologic, Q-bike and Newmen, covering bicycles, eyewear, protective gear, components and accessories for riders.

The company's news feed covers developments across its brands, including CUBE's sponsorship of professional cyclocross riders and 100%'s signature eyewear collaborations with elite athletes, which gives dealers a sense of the marketing and product pipeline behind the ranges they stock. Retailers interested in carrying these brands can apply to become an official dealer directly through the company's site. It suits bicycle shops and retailers looking to stock recognised international cycling brands through a single regional distributor, and the business is on Sterling Road in Samrand Business Park.

DRA Pharmaceuticals is a boutique pharmaceutical manufacturing and packaging company based in Route 21 Corporate Park, Irene, founded in 1997. The company develops, manufactures and packages scheduled medicines, complementary medicines, nutritional supplements, cosmetics and botanical products, combining pharmaceutical precision with natural-based formulation.

Its manufacturing capabilities include liquid and cream manufacturing for pharmaceuticals and cosmetics, and powder blending for veterinary, complementary and cosmetic markets, with production ranging from small batches of 20 to 50 kilograms up to large-scale runs of 1,000 kilograms. Its product development service covers research, formulation and rigorous testing, while its packaging facility handles both primary and secondary packaging, solid dosage form filling into bottles and securitainers, labelling, hand-packaging and re-packaging with quick turnaround times. It suits brand owners across the pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, cosmetic and veterinary sectors who need a flexible contract manufacturing partner, and the company is based on Victoria Link in Irene, Centurion.

items.description:
Dayenu Mining Consultants is a Pretoria-based mining engineering consultancy offering mine design, feasibility studies, planning and execution support across underground, open-cast, coal and mineral operations. The firm's name is a Hebrew word meaning "enough", reflecting its approach of giving clients the best product and service possible while staying compact enough to respond quickly and large enough to get the job done.

Its services include multidisciplinary engineering across mechanical, electrical and systems disciplines, simulation and modelling to predict and optimise operational performance, decision intelligence that turns complex datasets into actionable insights for executive leadership, and risk and safety engineering. The firm says it is trusted by major mining names including Harmony Gold, Impala Platinum, Sibanye Stillwater and Ivanhoe Mines. It suits mining operations that need technical studies and plans that hold up through execution, not just on paper, and the office is at Monument Office Park in Monument Park, Pretoria.

DebtQ is a South African debt recovery and collection agency with more than 15 years of experience, pursuing outstanding debts on behalf of businesses across all industries. The company says it has more leverage to collect debts than many collection agencies and is able to litigate when necessary, providing its service primarily on a contingent basis so clients pay largely on results.

Its in-depth understanding of South African laws, customs and cultures is presented as key to achieving the best possible debt mediation outcomes for clients. To start a case, clients are typically asked for copies of previous communications or emails, purchase orders, contact details, the exact legal entity name, and identity or passport numbers where the debtor is an individual. It suits businesses in any sector that need outstanding accounts recovered professionally, with contact handled through its Pretoria office.

Decor-D-Zign is a Pretoria-based event styling and décor company, with roots in the Silverton area under the banner Event Precision, providing creative direction, décor sourcing, installation and on-the-day coordination for weddings, corporate functions and private celebrations. Its Facebook page describes its philosophy, aim and reputation as its driving focus, and its local reviews put it on an affordable price range with the majority of reviewers recommending the business.

The company has built a following of more than 2,400 followers on social media, where it shares behind-the-scenes looks at its event styling work. It suits couples and event planners in Pretoria who want a décor company experienced in both local and larger-scale functions, and the business operates from the corner of Moreletta Street and Roberts Street in Silverton, Pretoria.

Diamond Corporation SA is a jewellery manufacturer based in Pretoria, specialising in engagement rings, wedding bands and custom-designed jewellery using both natural and lab-grown diamonds. Customers can design their own ring online in three steps, choosing from a selection of styles, diamonds and metals, or explore ready-made collections such as Classic, Halo, Vintage, Three Stone and Black Diamond designs.

Its range extends to men's wedding bands in tungsten and other metals, gifting pieces such as stud earrings and pendants, and a payment plan that lets a customer pay 20 percent upfront, fix the price for the first 30 days, and pay the balance over three to four months before the item is dispatched. The company reports more than 200 five-star Google reviews from customers praising their rings and buying experience. It suits couples planning an engagement or wedding who want a custom piece built around conflict-free diamonds and fair trade metal, with a showroom on Daventry Street in Lynnwood Manor.

Dic Homes is a real estate agency based in Raslouw, Centurion, offering property sales, rentals and valuations across Centurion, Pretoria, Midrand and Kempton Park. The agency is driven by a dynamic team of motivated, registered estate agents who follow professional guidelines when marketing a property, and recent listings handled by the team have ranged from apartments in Die Hoewes to a fifteen-bedroom smallholding in Mnandi.

Clients can sign up for property alerts to be the first to know about new listings, request a professional valuation of their own property, or ask the agency's property finder service to actively search for their ideal home. The agency is registered with the PPRA and affiliated with major property portals, giving its listings wide online visibility. It suits buyers, sellers, landlords and tenants across the greater Centurion area who want a locally based, professional agency, with the office in Raslouw.

Dick and Sue Home Finders is a residential real estate agency based in Murrayfield, Pretoria, operating since 1988 and handling property sales and rentals across suburbs including Silverton, La Montagne, Weavind Park, Eersterust, East Lynne, Equestria, Meyerspark, Monument Park and Val de Grace. Its listings cover residential apartments, houses and townhouses, with search tools for price range, bedrooms, bathrooms, garages, parking, land size and floor size.

Featured rental properties have included spacious family homes near good schools with expansive interiors, reflecting the agency's focus on family-oriented living in Pretoria's eastern suburbs. With decades of operating history in these specific neighbourhoods, the agency has built local knowledge of the area's streets, schools and amenities that newer entrants to the market would need years to match. It suits families and individuals looking to buy, sell, rent or let property in Pretoria's eastern suburbs, and the agency's office is on Eric Street in Murrayfield.

items.description:
The Ditsong National Museum of Cultural History is housed in the old South African Mint building on Visagie Street in Pretoria Central, and showcases the various stages and forms of culture in South Africa. It is part of the Ditsong Museums of South Africa network, which also includes the Natural History, Military History, Agricultural History, Pionier, Sammy Marks and Kruger museums, along with the Tswaing Meteorite Crater site.

The museum's exhibits cover South Africa's cultural diversity, including San rock art, Iron Age figurines and displays on the multicultural heritage of nearby Marabastad. The building itself, a former mint, adds a layer of historical interest to the collection housed within it, and the site is accessible via a Gautrain bus drop-off point. It suits history enthusiasts, school groups and visitors curious about South Africa's cultural heritage, with the museum located in the heart of Pretoria Central.

Doppio Zero Hazeldean is a branch of the South African casual dining chain, trading from Shop 42 at Hazeldean Retail Square on Silverlakes Road. The restaurant offers a signature wood-fired oven for its authentic Italian-style dishes, relaxed outdoor seating weather permitting, and a baby-friendly atmosphere with a baby chair and kids' menu available, plus wheelchair access via the front entrance.

Convenient on-site parking is available within the Hazeldean Square centre a short walk from the restaurant's door, and bookings are accepted for groups wanting a table reserved in advance. The branch forms part of a wider Doppio Zero and Doppio Caffè network across Gauteng and beyond, so travellers familiar with the brand elsewhere will recognise the same wood-fired menu and relaxed format here. It suits families with young children and groups wanting breakfast, lunch or dinner with both indoor and outdoor seating, and the restaurant is open seven days a week.

Dotcloud is an IT services provider based in Faerie Glen, Pretoria, founded in the late 1990s by two lifelong friends and tech entrepreneurs with deep roots in the IT industry. Its offering covers cloud services and consulting, security and backup, support solutions, hosting solutions and AI solutions, along with collaborative and productive tools and ISO compliance and certification support.

The company positions itself as a trusted technology partner known for a service-driven mindset and forward-thinking solutions, with a loyal and growing client base built up over more than two decades. A client testimonial from an attorneys' firm describes Dotcloud's team as knowledgeable, responsive and proactive, keeping IT systems secure, reliable and efficient while resolving issues with minimal disruption. It suits businesses that want a dependable, long-established IT partner for cloud, security, hosting and support services, and the company operates from Koedoeberg Road in Faerie Glen.

items.description:
ECAT Marketing is a family-run marketing agency established in 2002 and based in Constantia Park, Pretoria, describing itself as an African-leading digital agency. Its strategic marketing services include marketing strategy development, growth roadmaps, marketing workshops for leadership teams, market and customer research, and brand positioning and messaging.

On the execution side, the agency offers content marketing strategy and professional copywriting, AI SEO and consulting, social media marketing, and B2B and B2C web design, e-commerce systems and CRM and web development. ECAT tailors its marketing strategy to specific industries, including mining, manufacturing, electrical lighting, motors and drives, material handling, engineering and technical services, agriculture, schools, hospitality and air conditioning. It suits businesses in these specialised sectors that want marketing aligned to their industry rather than a generic approach, and the agency is based on Rudolf Street in Constantia Park.

Eco Square is an industrial and warehouse complex in Eco Park, Centurion, on Witch-Hazel Avenue, managed by property group M&T and offering retail-warehouse units from 80 square metres at around R120 per square metre. The complex is positioned as an eco-friendly, state-of-the-art destination for businesses seeking sustainable and modern warehouse solutions.

Security is a focus of the development, with advanced surveillance systems, access controls and on-site security personnel protecting tenants' goods and assets, alongside convenient amenities such as ample parking and easy access to major transportation routes for seamless logistics and distribution. Prospective tenants can contact M&T's commercial team directly to arrange a viewing of available space. It suits businesses looking for sustainable, secure warehouse or retail-warehouse space with good highway access, and the complex is on Witch-Hazel Avenue in Highveld, Centurion.

ECOTECH Converge is a well-established information technology, managed services and security provider based in Val de Grace, Pretoria, with more than 23 years as a trusted ICT infrastructure technology supplier. The company provides customised solutions ranging from traditional ICT through to cutting-edge cloud solutions, delivering turnkey, as-a-service managed ICT solutions scaled from the midmarket to the enterprise.

Its team includes more than 30 permanently appointed support engineers, from tier-one support through to architect level, and the company holds broad top-tier ICT vendor accreditation and partnerships that let it provide mature, holistic services. ECOTECH is a BBBEE Level 1 certified contributor in the ICT sector. It suits mid-market and enterprise businesses that want a long-established, accredited partner for cost-effective, reliable and secure IT solutions, and the Pretoria office is on Cussonia Avenue in Val de Grace, alongside a second office in Stellenbosch.

EDM Electronics is a specialist printed circuit board design and supply company based at Lobelia Office Park in Moreleta Park, Pretoria, specialising in design for manufacture since the year 2000. The team's combined expertise in PCB design spans more than 50 years, with a datapack format refined over the years to a standard respected by the PCB manufacturing and assembly industries globally.

Through its global PCB manufacturing partnership network, the company can fulfil technical and manufacturing volume requirements including HDI, multilayer, rigid-flex, aluminium, flex and heavy copper boards, as well as RF and microwave designs, with impedance control implemented wherever required and a choice of finishes such as ENIG, immersion tin and immersion silver. Additional services include solder paste stencils, small-batch final assembly, wiring looms, mechanical part manufacture, programming and testing, pre-project consultation and quality inspections. It suits engineering teams and manufacturers across digital, analog, high-power and RF electronics who need PCB design and assembly handled by specialists, and the office is on Lobelia Street in Moreleta Park.

Elardi Tuisnywerheid is a home industry bakery in The Park Shopping Centre, Elardus Park, known for personalised birthday cakes and other baked goods made to order. Its Facebook page describes the business as a place where finger-licking goods get new meaning, with more than 1,200 followers and a 78 percent recommendation rate from customers reviewing the bakery.

The business also prepares savouries and home-cooked meals to order, which extends its offering to corporate functions and events alongside everyday cake and baked goods orders. Updates on its page share seasonal posts, such as reminders about upcoming school holidays, keeping regular customers informed of what to expect from the bakery through the year. It suits families ordering a birthday cake, and businesses or event organisers looking for home-cooked catering, and the bakery is at the corner of Barnard and Delmas Road in Elardus Park.

Elevator Maintenance Company, known as EMC, is a multi-brand lift and elevator company based in Hermanstad, Pretoria, servicing, maintaining, installing and repairing all major elevator and lift brands, including KONE, Otis, ThyssenKrupp, Schindler and Mitsubishi. Its work follows SABS ISO 9001-certified standards, with every service designed to keep passengers and buildings secure.

The company offers routine maintenance, modernisation and upgrades, elevator repairs, and support and training, backing its work with fast, consistent and 24/7-supported services so lifts keep performing smoothly. Its technicians bring decades of experience across all major brands to both high-rise office blocks and residential buildings, serving corporates, property managers and homeowners alike. It suits building owners and managers who want one accountable partner for all their elevators regardless of brand, and the company offers a free site audit to assess a building's existing lifts, operating from Helen Street in Hermanstad.

EPH Group is a South African event technical production company based in Rietvalleirand, Pretoria, with over 40 years of accumulated team experience delivering audio, lighting, LED, staging, structures and AV for events. The company designs, supplies and executes the full technical environment for corporate conferences, exhibitions, festivals and live shows, taking responsibility for the outcome rather than simply supplying equipment.

Its hands-on team pairs experienced industry professionals with driven younger talent, working alongside agencies, event planners and brands to deliver technically demanding events under tight timelines and complex builds. EPH describes itself as one of South Africa's leading event technical production companies, taking ownership of the technical delivery from concept through to final execution so an event runs exactly as it should. It suits event organisers and agencies who need a single technical partner for audio, lighting, LED display walls and stage construction, and the company is based on View Street in Rietvalleirand.

EPI-USE Labs develops software and managed services that optimise SAP systems, based in Lynnwood Glen, Pretoria, and part of the wider Group Elephant network serving clients in around 50 countries. Its software covers SAP HCM and payroll tools including the HCM Productivity Suite, Query Manager and its add-ons, Document Builder, Payroll Pack, Variance Monitor and GeoClock, alongside its Data Sync Manager suite for system builds, object sync and client sync.

The company's work spans transforming SAP landscapes, managing SAP data privacy, security and risk, optimising SAP data, achieving an intelligent HR enterprise, and modernising SAP systems in the cloud, including cloud and S/4HANA migrations. Its client success stories include helping major international brands improve data privacy compliance, land successfully in SAP SuccessFactors, and streamline HR reporting. It suits large organisations running SAP and SAP SuccessFactors systems that need specialist tools for data management, testing and HR reporting, and the Pretoria office is on Ingersol Road in Lynnwood Glen.

Ericssons Mattress and Pine is a long-established, family-run furniture retailer specialising in pine furniture, beds and mattresses manufactured in South Africa, with this showroom on Kwartsiet Crescent in Centurion alongside outlets in Pretoria West and The Willows. Its mattress range includes Medibed, Contour Bedding, Cloud Nine, Rest Assured, Sealy Posturepedic, Strand Foam and Strandmattress, along with mattress toppers and a new range of adjustable beds, plus base sets to complete a bedroom setup.

The Centurion store offers free secure parking and is open seven days a week, with free delivery on online orders over R3,500 within a 30 kilometre radius of any of its stores, and set delivery charges for smaller orders or greater distances. The retailer has earned a Top Rated Provider certificate for 2026, verified by Trustindex based on a review score above 4.5 over the past year. It suits households furnishing a bedroom who want pine furniture and a wide choice of mattress brands from a long-running local retailer.

Excellence Marketing is a residential letting and selling agency based in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion, in business since 2002 and now one of the leading such agencies in the area with a book of more than 250 units. Its portfolio includes simplexes, duplexes and stack simplexes, alongside other residential property types, giving the agency a strong footprint in the local rental and sales market.

The agency's site lets buyers and tenants search listings by price range, with separate sections for residential and commercial rentals and sales, as well as a dedicated business listings category. Tools available to clients include a bond and affordability calculator, the option to list a property directly through the site, and downloadable documents for tenants and landlords. It suits landlords and tenants in Centurion who want an agency with a large, established rental book and over a decade of local experience, and the office is on Emerald Avenue in Lyttelton Manor.

ExploSpot Systems is a global leader in advanced explosion, fire and dust suppression solutions, founded in 1994 and based in Zwavelpoort, Pretoria. Since then, the company has delivered cutting-edge safety technologies engineered to protect people, equipment and infrastructure in the world's most hazardous environments, from underground mining operations to military vehicles and critical industrial applications.

Its automated suppression systems are trusted worldwide for their ultrafast response, reliability and compliance with international safety standards, backed by decades of research and development, including industry-first qualifications and collaborations with leading institutions. The company's active explosion barriers have been credited with preventing methane ignition escalation at coal mines including Forzando South and Syferfontein. With a footprint spanning Africa, Australia, China, Europe, the Middle East and the USA, its mission is to prevent disaster before it strikes. It suits mining, industrial and military operators who need certified explosion, fire and dust suppression systems, and the company is based at Zwavelpoort Road.

Firmlogik is an electronics engineering, design and manufacturing company based at Factory @ N4 in The Willows, Pretoria, with an emphasis on designs suited for manufacturing so that products can move from concept to production quickly. The company developed from a start-up in 2010 with only two senior engineers into a productive business today, employing skilled electronic engineers, technicians and production staff.

Its work covers prototype development, component procurement, pick-and-place production and full assembly and testing of custom electronic products, built for industries including cash-in-transit, telecommunications, fuel and mining, where equipment must perform reliably in demanding conditions. The company positions its engineers' experience as the key to delivering high-quality solutions in very short time-frames, even for highly customised designs. It suits businesses in these specialised industries that need a local partner for custom electronics from prototype through to finished product, and the business is on Rooiberg Street in The Willows.

FreshStop at Caltex Wapadrand is a forecourt convenience store at the corner of Lynnwood and Wapadrand Road, offering customers convenience on the go with snacks and fresh produce options around the clock. The store includes a grab-and-go station and gourmet coffee from Seattle Coffee Company, so customers filling up can also pick up breakfast or a quick meal.

Beyond the convenience store itself, the site offers restrooms, an Aramex courier point, GloCell services, a car wash and free WiFi, plus an ABSA ATM for cash withdrawals. Customers can also swipe their UCount rewards card while filling up with fuel. It suits motorists on the Lynnwood and Wapadrand route who need fuel, a quick coffee or snacks at any hour, and the station sits within Wapadrand Security Village in Pretoria.

FutureSoft is a software development company based in Highveld Techno Park, Centurion, known for its Excalibur debt-collection and credit-management software. Excalibur is built to integrate seamlessly with a business's existing systems and evolve alongside it, offering real-time insights and intelligent automation rather than simply automating routine tasks, aimed at businesses that want more than a basic collections tool.

Around Excalibur, the company has built the Merlin suite of artificial intelligence tools, bringing conversational assistance, communication analytics, transcription and sentiment intelligence into one connected AI product family that supports every client interaction. FutureSoft's software is used by law firms and debt-collection agencies across South Africa, the rest of Africa and the UK. It suits collections teams that want to unlock the full potential of their collections strategy with software built specifically for debt recovery, and the company is based on Witch-Hazel Avenue in Highveld Techno Park.

Gauteng Motors is a used-car dealership on Kgosi Mampuru Street in Pretoria Central, trading for over 30 years and offering pre-owned vehicles from brands including BMW, Volkswagen, Mercedes-Benz, Mini, Lexus, Land Rover and Audi. The dealership's showroom is reachable directly by phone, and customers can apply for in-house vehicle finance through the dealership's own application process.

Its sales department keeps regular weekday and Saturday hours, with a midday break on Fridays, and the dealership publishes customer testimonials alongside its stock listings for buyers researching a purchase. It suits buyers in Pretoria looking for a premium pre-owned vehicle with finance arranged on site, and the dealership is at 323 Kgosi Mampuru Street in Pretoria Central.
